name: Blue Ghost Mission 2

surface_window.note: The landing date is not published.

outcome_note: Planned to be the first American landing on the Moon's far side, carrying three NASA payloads (NASA, Aug 2026).

payloads.name: LuSEE-Night
payloads.organisation: Brookhaven National Lab and Lawrence Berkeley Lab (DOE)
payloads.purpose: Low-frequency radio telescope operating through the lunar night.

sources.title: NASA Provides Updates on Moon Base Cargo Landers, Tech Demonstrations (Aug 04, 2026)

notes: NASA counts three payloads; its CS-3/4 page names one (LuSEE-Night).
